name: Catherine
source:
Role: Chronicler
[Spoiler]A friendship that was cut before it could fully bloom. I've never seen her face and I miss her dearly. I've heard so much about her good works, but I have so many questions about what seem to be her flaws. I feel ghastly picking over the remains of her relationships, but I suppose it has to be done...[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the in-game description]
